$comment: Growth ack for #3951 (epic #3473, criterion B7). One path, one sentence's worth of growth. `gsd-core/workflows/quick.md` line 627 asserted that `gsd_run quick-tasks-append --task <text>` 'performs the equivalent write' to the Step 7c row rendered directly above it. That claim was FALSE and is the documented half of #3356: the route had no way to receive a quick id or a task directory, so it emitted a positional ordinal in the `#` cell and an em-dash in `Directory` — a visibly different row from the one the workflow itself renders. #3356 was CLOSED with that defect still live in source; both halves were fixed in this deliverable (the route gained optional `--quick-id`/`--slug`/`--directory`, and it now passes `{ resync: false }` so a body-only append stops re-deriving `progress.*` over curated values). The prose grows because the corrected sentence has to carry three facts the original elided: what the shortcut actually writes when it has neither an id nor a directory, that this is the honest behavior for its real caller (`fast.md`, which has neither), and how a caller that DOES have both gets the byte-identical canonical row. Prose is the product here — an executing agent reads this line to decide whether the shortcut is safe for its case, and the original wording told it 'equivalent' when it was not. A shorter correction would either drop the flags (leaving the reader unable to act on the fix) or drop the limitation (recreating the false claim in gentler words).

quick.md.reason: #3356 / #3951: replaces the false 'performs the equivalent write' claim at line 627 with an accurate one — naming that the `#` cell is a positional ordinal and `Directory` reads an em-dash when no id or task directory is supplied (the `fast.md` case, unchanged and byte-identical to before), and naming the new optional `--quick-id`/`--slug`/`--directory` flags that produce the canonical row the step above renders. Measured 2026-08-27 against origin/next: 37232 -> 37584 bytes (+352). The base figure moves as origin/next advances — the growth this ack covers is the corrected sentence and the flag list, nothing else.
